cwes.name: External Control of File Name
cwes.description: External Control of File Name occurs when security controls are improperly implemented or validated.
cwes.impact: May lead to data leakage, unauthorized access, service disruption, or system compromise.
prevention: Never trust file names from user input
fixation: Remove direct user control on file paths
Use mapping instead of raw file names
